dedupe_keys.name: lecce georeferenced school buildings used for polling 2019

description: Lecce identifies the school buildings hosting its 102 electoral sections in 2019 and lists georeferenced building-location exports. This record covers the physical polling venues. Separate voter-count distributions are present in the package but are not treated as infrastructure data or facility capacity. There need not be 102 distinct buildings. Actual geometries, facility names and building condition were not inspected. Coverage is Lecce, Puglia, Italy. The licence declared by native metadata is CC-BY-4.0. The public catalogue provides descriptive metadata and the listed distribution links. Costs, access conditions for later file use and present completeness remain unknown. The supplied facts come from source descriptions and distribution labels; data values and file contents were not inspected. No specific simulation method is documented. Related resources may overlap this inventory or time period, but no further exact relationship is established by the inspected metadata.
